disposition_reason: EFSA technical report on a traditional-food notification for fresh Wolffia plants; Table 1.d prints applicant data on mercury, arsenic, cadmium, lead and chromium in six dried batches from an indoor vertical farm, and Table 1.c minerals in seven batches.

study.design: Regulatory technical report with applicant-supplied batch analyses
study.origin: Indoor aquatic vertical farm with LED lighting and deionized water (clones from a US university duckweed collection); notifier based in Israel, farm location not stated
study.method: not stated; samples dried at 40 °C for 24 h
lod: Non-detects printed as <0.020 (Hg), <0.100 or <0.010 (As), <0.050 or <0.010 (Cd), <0.100 (Pb) mg/kg; copper LOQ 10 mg/kg
